title: Domain capability profile
description: A versioned description of what a kind of software needs: skills, tools, evidence and gates, plus the actions an autonomous run must never take. A profile states requirements. It does not claim that any tool exists. Every declared tool has to be probed before the profile can be active, and a mandatory gate whose tool is missing blocks promotion instead of becoming a warning. New domains are added by adding profile files, with no change to the orchestration code. Profile files may be written in YAML or JSON.

status.description: A missing value means draft. Only active profiles may drive a production job.

matches.description: Domain tags this profile applies to. A job may match several profiles.

mandatory_gates.description: Gates that must pass. If one cannot run, promotion is blocked.

forbidden_autonomous_actions.description: Actions that always need a human, such as placing live orders.

argv.description: Typed argument vector that proves the tool is present, for example the tool and --version.

review.description: Profiles are reviewed and tested like production code.

timestamp.description: UTC instant in RFC 3339 form with a Z suffix.

slug.description: Machine-safe identifier: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen. For metadata fields, never for human-facing titles.

humanTitle.description: Short plain-English title in sentence case. Machine identifiers, role stamps and pipeline tags belong in separate metadata fields, never in the title.

humanText.description: Complete plain-English sentences written for a human reader.
